question: Who among the following is the author of the book published in December 2021, ‘The Monk Who Transformed Uttar Pradesh’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shantanu Gupta**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shantanu Gupta** is the author of the book *'The Monk Who Transformed Uttar Pradesh'*.
 
• The book was published in December 2021 and highlights the work and impact of Yogi Adityanath, the Chief Minis
